Our Services

Personalized, custom, private guided holidays
It’s like having a true friend in Vietnam plan your vacation and show you around!

The Best Vietnam Tour COmpany for a Reason

There are many companies offering tours and vacations in Vietnam.  Why choose Little Vietnam Tours?  Most simply, we care.  We are Van & Richard, and we created Little Vietnam Tours because travel and helping people are our passions, and we want to make travel affordable and accessible.  We don't create package tours, no fixed dates, no middle-man markup--only years of experience and knowledge to build a vacation or holiday you will love.  We work with you individually to create a custom itinerary just for you.  We take pride in our attention to all your details.

OUR TEAM

​A Vietnam native living in Hanoi, Van (Vicky) has 18+ years of experience creating holidays and vacations for thousands of clients, taking them on memorable journeys throughout Vietnam and SE Asia.  Based in the US, Richard has traveled the world for the past 24 years, with 30 years of experience in business and guest satisfaction.

Our travel consultants and tour operators take pride in providing personalized journeys with unique experiences tailored around "you".  Naomi loves traveling & exploring new places and is passionate about helping people discover new destinations and making sure they have a great experience along the way.  Linda believes tourism is about turning bucket-list dreams and into unforgettable realities.  She is deeply passionate about crafting unique adventures that connects people with the heart of new cultures and let travelers experience the world to the fullest.
​
Van (Vicky) Nguyen, Hanoi, Vietnam
Richard Lambakis, Pasadena CA, USA
Naomi Tran
Linda To
Send us a note, tell us what type of travel experience you are looking for, and we'll suggest experienced ideas on the best places to visit in Vietnam, give you honest opinions about destinations, hotels and activities, and put together a free custom itinerary.  We are independent, and choose to only work with quality hotels, knowledgeable guides, and quality local companies.  We are highly rated by our clients for a reason.
​
Contact Us

Personalized

You don't join a group tour, we sit down with you (via WhatsApp, Zoom or phone) to plan an custom itinerary based on your desires, interests and parameters.  We’ll give you our honest, experienced suggestions based on your interests, and you are in control of exactly how you want to spend each day.

Private

Your time is precious, and you shouldn’t have to sacrifice it or share it.  Your itinerary will be your own, with your own private guide.  Some daily activities may join other group tours to meet locals and other travelers, and will be explicit when making your itinerary.

Guided

You’ll have your own private experienced guide for the duration of your trip, to get you from place to place, work the details along the way, and provide insights and personal knowledge of the country and culture.  You can decide how involved you would like your guide to be.  We hire only the best local people as they are key to ensuring you have a fantastic experience.
​

​Knowledge, experience, and limitless options

With 16 years of experience planning holidays for people from all over the world, we know and can suggest a seemingly endless list of options for you to choose from.  We know the best places to visit in Vietnam, the best hotels (and those to avoid) no matter what your budget and style, the best foods and local restaurants, the nooks and crannies--places to visit, activities, restaurants, transportation, and more.  We will never recommend a hotel, restaurant or activity because it is more convenient or profitable for us.

Personal Travel COnsultant

From your initial planning until the moment you finish your trip, you’ll have a personal, local consultant in Vietnam to rely on whose only goal is you being happy with every aspect of your trip.

We Care

Other companies offer private, custom tours.  But one of the main reasons we started this business was because we care about people really enjoying their vacation/holiday, and experiencing the country.  No matter who you choose, make sure they have your best interest at heart.  Send us an inquiry, speak with Van (Vicky), Linda and Naomi and see for yourself.

Attention to Detail

Caring means paying attention to every detail, which we take pride in.  We plan and book everything from when you arrive to when you leave--hotels, in-tour flights and transportation, activities and many meals.  In planning every activity in your itinerary, choosing only the best guides, following up as weather changes, making sure everyone will be happy and every concern is anticipated.  We’ll give you tips for packing and preparing for your trip as well and answer all of your questions.

Costs

Travel planning is not expensive.  Costs are based on your choices of accommodation and travel, etc--we can book luxury resorts or budget hotels, and only charge a modest percentage for the service and value we add.  We look for and negotiate the best prices on your hotels, activities, transportation, etc.  And Little Vietnam Tours is not beholden to any vendor.
​
Contact Us


A ​Custom Itinerary means You Choose:

  • Where you go, what you experience – Types of destinations, countries, activities
  • How you travel – Quick plane, scenic bus, flexible car, or nostalgic and inexpensive train
  • Pace – Slow and relaxed, or make sure you see it all
  • Number of days – 6 days, 2 weeks, 3 weeks or anything in-between
  • Type of lodging experience - From homestays to 5-star resorts
  • Food – From popular tourist cafes, to top rated, to “keep my taste buds in suspense”, to 5-star
  • Guide – Someone to narrate the whole trip, or just take care of logistics

It’s like having a friend in Vietnam to help plan your vacation!

To get started, if you have an idea of what you want to see and do, read our Sample Itineraries.  These are just ideas—many people will find one that appeals to them as a base, from which you can personalize with your own interests by speaking with Van.

If you're not sure where to go and what to do, start by reading About Vietnam, where we give you our own thoughts and experiences about each area.  After familiarizing yourself with the areas, check out some of Little Vietnam Tours' sample itineraries and one might start to appeal to you.  Then send us an inquiry!
-- Van (Vicky) & Richard
